package.name: varietas_moveit
package.description: A MoveIt kinematics plugin built on varietas. For a six-joint arm whose last three axes meet, it splits the arm at its wrist centre when it is loaded, solves the arm that places the centre exactly, and answers every IK query with all the configurations that reach the pose, fitted into the joint ranges MoveIt knows, the one nearest the seed first. No code is generated for the robot; set kinematics_solver to varietas_moveit/VarietasKinematicsPlugin in kinematics.yaml.
